notes: All data is SIMULATED. These numbers describe the prototype rules on simulated data, not clinical performance.
NOMINAL: 5 seeds x 72 sim hours x 4 crew = 60 crew days, analytics every 15 sim minutes. Every alert in NOMINAL counts as a false alert.
falseAlertsPerCrewDay counts crew alerts at HIGH or above; moderateAlertsPerCrewDay counts crew alerts at MODERATE or above (any rule).
NOMINAL crew alerts by rule: none. Cabin alerts: 0.

Scenario times are minutes from the scenario start (08:00 UTC sim time), measured on the evaluation grid: ACUTE_CARDIO every 1 min, SENSOR_FAILURE every 1 min, ENVIRONMENTAL_CO2 every 5 min, PROGRESSIVE_FATIGUE every 15 min, PERFORMANCE_DECLINE every 15 min.
Level = the target astronaut attention level (cabin scenario: worst of the cabin status and the crew levels).
Self report (check-ins) feeds recommendations and risk factors but never raises alerts on its own.
